title: An Analysis of the Navy's Fiscal Year 2027 Shipbuilding Plan
summary_raw: CBO estimates that the average annual cost to implement the Navy's 2027 shipbuilding plan, which covers fiscal years 2027 to 2056, would be $53.8 billion (in 2026 dollars), including $48.9 billion for new-ship construction.
